status: proposed finite inputs only, not reference output captures
sample_format: stereo floating unit-amplitude scale; independently validate source and channel routing before use

signals.S0: 2 seconds exact digital zero per channel, followed by S1; not proof of absence of a generator or tail
signals.S1: 3 seconds at each selected host rate: first second500Hz sine peak0.1 L/R identical; second second500Hz sine peak0.8 L and750Hz sine peak0.5 R; third second sine at0.4 times host rate peak0.3 L and negative same in R. Phase begins0 at each segment.
signals.S2: 2 seconds500Hz sine with nonzero amplitude bursts:0–0.25s peak0.05;0.25–0.5s peak0.7;0.5–0.75s peak0.05;0.75–1s zero; repeat once. L/R identical; discontinuities are input, not device artifacts.
signals.S3: 3 seconds sequential100Hz,1000Hz,6000Hz sine tones peak0.3 one second each, L=R; separate2-second input of500Hz sine peak0.2 plus DC0.1 L and DC-0.1 R. Tone and DC observations are separate.

P-AUDIO: independently verify source has intended nonzero segment and channel data
independently verify selected active device/stage/model and signal route, no unrelated solo/mute/filter/gate
independently verify a tested control and modulation depth/amount are nonzero where their influence is claimed
independently verify nonmuted processed output and dry/return/direct isolation, use100%wet only if documented and verified available
retain positive signal-sensitive and tested-control-sensitive baseline for the same path, including follower/matrix/feedback/generator if applicable
hold or independently isolate other paths, stage gates, modulation, input level and normalization
if any prerequisite lacks independent evidence, the claimed effect/no-effect result is U; null cannot become pass
measurement_limits: No output oracle, aliasing filter, distortion law, random distribution, matching tolerance, silence threshold or DSP equality is supplied. Inputs are experiments to resolve U, not proof of behavior.
